### The Cornerstone and Foundation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/cornerstone-and-foundation
Passage: Ephesians 2:20
Points:
- Through the finished work of Christ, believers are no longer outsiders but full citizens in God's household.
- Unlike modern ceremonial stones, ancient cornerstones set the standard against which every other stone was measured and aligned.
- As stones in God's spiritual temple, Christians must be continually conformed to the image of Jesus through daily discipleship.
- The apostles and prophets serve as the foundation because the Holy Spirit inspired them to deliver and record God's authoritative Word.
